name: 小雨西游utf8
english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West (UTF-8 Snapshot)
english_description: Another independent archive of the Xiaoyu Xiyou / Xiaoyu Xiyou II engine, its filename flagging that it had already been pre-converted to UTF-8. Though it shares an engine family with this project's xyxy2 and xiaoyuxiyou snapshots, a content-hash comparison shows it is not a byte-for-byte duplicate (8,753 vs. 11,149 .lpc files) — it's a snapshot from a different point in time, not just a re-encoding, so it was processed as its own distinct archive. Its map includes Aolai Country, the actual birthplace of Sun Wukong in the original novel, giving it geography closer to the source text than most other games in this family.
